notes: כַּאֲשֶׁר is taken as one fused unit under rule 30 rather than split, headed on the governing opening morpheme (rule 23); the competing reading would give *as* to the כְּ and mark אֲשֶׁר unrepresented, which rule 30 forbids where one English word carries both senses.

*the king's son* is a possessive recasting, so the *the* determines the possessor and goes to the article on מֶּלֶךְ (rule 29), while `בֵית הָאֱלֹהִים` → *the house of God* is the fronting case, the rectum being rendered anarthrously.
